project.name: Portfolio Website
project.summary: kylet.se, Kyle Tse's personal site: four static pages built with Keel Engine (Rust components exported to HTML by keel-web), one island and one live Keel scene, served by nginx on Sylphx Hosting.
goals: Ship kylet.se as a static Keel Engine site (keel pack --profile web).
nonGoals: A server-side API or on-site agent (retired 2026-09-28; the API was stateless).
Owning Keel Engine or Sylphx Platform internals.

owns.name: site
owns.description: Routes, copy, theme and islands in site/; the live scene in scenes/.

owns.name: hosting
owns.description: Dockerfile, nginx.conf and sylphx.toml: the image that serves the pack, its headers, redirects and 410s.

doesNotOwn: Keel Engine (SylphxAI/keel), consumed at the revision in KEEL_PIN.
Cluster deploy, build secrets and ingress (SylphxAI/cloud).

allowedDependencies.surface: keel-ui, keel-web, keel-engine crates and the keel CLI at KEEL_PIN
sylphx.toml service manifest and deploy bindings

forbiddenCouplings: Hand-written HTML, CSS or JS that Keel can express (site CSS only for named Keel gaps).
A credential in git, a git URL or an image layer.

delivery.deployPath: Sylphx manifest (sylphx.toml): one web service, a Docker image that runs keel pack and serves dist/web with nginx.
delivery.productionProof: curl -sI https://kylet.se (200), /about, /colophon, /story (301), /stats (410), /no-such-page (404); tests/browser.mjs against the live origin.

guardrails: No paid product surface in this repository.
